newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy electricity demand up 0.9 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: Italy electricity demand up 0.9 pct in October.

text.p: Electricity consumption in Italy rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in October, utility company ENEL said on Friday.
It said in a statement that the slight rise was in line with "a weak economic cycle present since the beginning of the year and which seemed to have come to an end last month."
In the first 10 months of 1996, electricity consumption rose just 0.4 percent compared with the same period last year.
ENEL said the service sector was the main source of electricity demand, while demand in the industrial sector was still in decline. Domestic demand remained stagnant.
In total, Italy used up 22.6 billion kWh of electricity in October. Italian producers supplied some 19.4 billion kWh of this demand, up 1.5 percent on October 1995.
